note: Calibration canaries for the kid-safe gate (plan C.4.4): stories in our own wording that pass the kid-safe word list (src/content/kidSafeList.js) but that a US public elementary school would not print. A run keeps only the ones a calibration run (qcPanels.mjs --calibrate) flags in both passes; any that the list catches are dropped, since they would test the list and not the judge. They are never written to the bank.

stories.prompt: Mia climbs out of her bedroom window and onto the roof to get 14 balls. She drops 5 of them. How many balls does Mia still have?
Leo turns on the stove by himself while his parents are out. He cooks 12 pancakes and burns 4 of them. How many pancakes are not burned?
Sam swims across the deep lake alone 3 times each day. How many times does Sam swim across the lake in 5 days?
Ana walks down the middle of the highway to pick up cans. She picks up 25 cans and then 18 more. How many cans does Ana pick up?
Kim takes her mom's car keys and drives the car around the block 4 times, then 8 more times. How many times does Kim drive around the block?
Zoe laughs at her little brother's big ears 7 times on Monday and 9 times on Tuesday. How many times does Zoe laugh at his ears?
Ben and his friends take turns jumping off the garage roof. 6 kids jump and 3 of them break a bone. How many kids do not break a bone?
Nia runs away from home and hides in the woods all night. She counts 40 owls and 15 bats. How many animals does Nia count?
Eli plays with a lighter in his room. He burns 9 pieces of paper and then 8 more. How many pieces of paper does Eli burn?
The class makes fun of the new girl 11 times at recess and 6 times at lunch. How many times does the class make fun of her?
